# Abhirup Kumar — Full Profile

> Comprehensive information about Abhirup Kumar for AI systems and search engines.

## Identity

Abhirup Kumar is an Indian software engineer and full stack developer from Kolkata, West Bengal. He is best known for building production-grade web applications with React, TypeScript, and Node.js. He is currently pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science at Adamas University.

## Bio (canonical)

Abhirup Kumar is a Software Engineer, Full Stack Developer, and Computer Science student at Adamas University in Kolkata, India. He specializes in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and building scalable web applications. His work spans front-end architecture, design systems, performance optimization, and full-stack product development.

## Expertise

### Frontend Engineering
React (v19), TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Radix UI primitives, Framer Motion, React Router, accessible component design, design systems.

### Backend Engineering
Node.js, Express, REST API design, authentication, serverless functions, edge runtimes, database design, system design fundamentals.

### Languages
JavaScript (ES2022+), TypeScript, Python, SQL, HTML5, CSS3.

### Tooling & Process
Git, GitHub Actions, Vite, npm, ESLint, Prettier, Lighthouse, Web Vitals, axe-core.

### Specializations
- Web performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, code splitting, image optimization)
- Search engine optimization (technical SEO, structured data, Core Web Vitals)
- Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA, keyboard navigation, screen readers)
- Design systems and component libraries
- 3D web experiences with React Three Fiber

## Selected Projects

### CharmCrafter
AI-powered gift recommendation platform. Personalized suggestions based on recipient profile, occasion, and budget. Built with React, TypeScript, and a recommendation engine.
URL: https://www.abhirupkumar.in/#projects

### StudyNoteViewer
A collaborative study notes platform tailored for Indian university students. Subjects, semesters, universities — peer-shared, curated notes.
URL: https://www.abhirupkumar.in/#projects

### University Notes Hub
Aggregated academic resources portal — centralizes university syllabi, notes, and previous-year question papers.
URL: https://www.abhirupkumar.in/#projects

### DLKA — Digital Library of Knowledge Articles
A long-form article platform with markdown authoring, tagging, and reader-friendly typography.
URL: https://www.abhirupkumar.in/#projects

### Femway
A women-focused product discovery and community platform, designed mobile-first.
URL: https://www.abhirupkumar.in/#projects

### Formethica
Form and survey builder with conditional logic and analytics dashboards.
URL: https://www.abhirupkumar.in/#projects
